newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle details H1 sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Nestle details H1 sales growth.

text.p: Nestle SA said 2.7 percent volume growth as well as favourable currency rates helped boost first-half sales 17.5 percent to 33.5 billion Swiss francs.
"The favourable foreign exchange rates contributed nearly 11 percent to the increase in consolidated sales," it said in a statement on first-half turnover.
"Real internal growth, not including acquisitions and divestments, stands at 2.7 percent, while it amounted to only 2.2 percent during the first three months of the year."
"Internal growth rates were particularly high in North America and in Eastern Europe, as well as in the Middle East and in Southeast Asian countries," it said.

"Significant progress was realised in pet care products, in the Perrier-Vittel group and in Alcon. Coffee also showed positive volume growth, in spite of the price increases made necessary as a result of the rise in green coffee prices."
It gave no other details on sales.
